product.description: Monoprice™Cat6 Ethernet Patch Cable – Bendable, UTP, 28AWGFlexible Installation with Long-Lasting Signal IntegrityExperience fast, reliable, and clutter-free networking with our Cat6 Ethernet Patch Cable, engineered for high-performance connectivity in modern homes, offices, and data environments. Designed to support bandwidths up to 250MHz and speeds up to 1Gbps, it ensures stable, low-latency connections for streaming, gaming, video conferencing, cloud computing, and everyday network demands.Built with UTP (Unshielded Twisted Pair) construction, this Ethernet patch cable delivers excellent signal integrity while minimizing interference in standard networking environments. It is fully compliant with Cat6 standards and backward compatible with Cat5e and Cat5, making it a versatile choice for upgrading existing networks or building new ones from the ground up.One standout feature of this cable is its bendable, flexible molded boot. The low-profile molded strain relief protects the RJ45 connectors from excessive bending and wear, reducing the risk of damage at stress points. This flexible design simplifies installation in tight spaces—behind desks, inside server racks, or around corners—while maintaining a secure and reliable connection.The slim 28AWG design sets this Cat6 patch cable apart from traditional, bulkier cables. Its reduced diameter improves airflow in crowded racks and cable trays, helping maintain optimal equipment cooling. The lightweight, flexible construction also enables cleaner, more manageable routing, resulting in a professional, organized appearance without sacrificing performance.Durability is built into every detail. High-quality copper conductors ensure consistent signal transmission, while the robust outer jacket resists everyday wear, bending, and repeated plugging cycles. Gold-plated RJ45 contacts enhance conductivity and corrosion resistance, delivering long-lasting performance even in demanding environments.Designed for broad compatibility, this Cat6 Ethernet patch cable works seamlessly with a wide range of devices, including routers, modems, switches, network interface cards, patch panels, gaming consoles, smart TVs, desktop and laptop computers, printers, IP cameras, and VoIP phones. Whether used in residential settings, commercial offices, or data centers, it provides dependable connectivity you can trust.To meet diverse installation needs, the cable is available in multiple lengths (measured in feet), allowing you to choose the right size without excess slack or tension. A variety of color options further simplifies cable identification, color-coded network management, and customized setups.Combining performance, flexibility, durability, and clean aesthetics, this Cat6 Ethernet Patch Cable is an ideal solution for efficient, high-speed networking with a modern, slim-profile design.
